| `spec.service.affinity` | object | no | Rules that attract or repel this service by node and workload labels. |

| `spec.service.tolerations` | list of object | no | Node taints this service may be placed despite. |
| `spec.service.user` | string | no | Container user as a name or uid, optionally :group or :gid. |
| `spec.service.volumes` | list of object | no | Named volumes or host bind mounts to mount into the container. |
| `spec.service.working_dir` | string | no | Absolute working directory that overrides the image's WORKDIR. |
| `spec.service.workload` | `replicated`, `per-node`, `ordered` | no | Reserved, not yet scheduled. Workload kind: replicated, per-node or ordered. |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spec.active_health` | object | no | Periodic health requests sent to each replica. |

| `spec.retries` | object | no | Retry behavior for failed requests. |
| `spec.slow_start` | string | no | Time over which a new replica ramps up to full traffic. |
| `spec.upstream_tls` | object | no | TLS settings for connections to replicas. |
| `spec.weights` | list of integer | no | Relative weight per replica when algorithm is weighted. |
